narration: In month {fork_month}, the bank asked when your saving should happen, and you chose {real_choice}. The ghost took {ghost_choice}, and its {first_bar_apart} score parted from yours straight away. The ghost's money reached its low point in month {ghost_lowest_month}. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}, and the two lives were never further apart. By month {end_month}, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. Its cushion, should the pay stop, ran {safety_gap}.
